answers: Dr David Blaney suggested that the main challenge was finding the money. Although there was an additional £6.6 million allocated for research very recently by the Government, that was not sustainable and certainly not enough. Also, the Welsh government had recently issued their own vision for research and innovation and more investment in the Welsh research base would make the Welsh universities be more competitive in accessing funding at a UK level.

full.prediction: The loss of EU funding due to Brexit is expected to have a significant impact on future research in Wales. To mitigate this, the Reid review recommended strategies to help universities transition away from EU funding, including increased investment in the Welsh research base to enhance competitiveness for UK-wide funding opportunities. Additionally, there are plans to reallocate funds to support innovation and improve the ability of Welsh institutions to access external research funding, such as from UKRI.
